title: The Deep Country That Speaks in Silence

features.name: unmarked-rows
features.desc-on-touch: Row after row of stones or posts, each one exactly alike, none of them named. The country has learned that names are a kind of noise, and has chosen the silence underneath.

features.name: listening-place
features.desc-on-touch: A clearing where nothing is said and everything is received. You can almost hear the country's own thoughts, the way it remembers itself without needing to speak a name.

features.name: removed-landmark
features.desc-on-touch: Something stood here—a sign, a marker, a place where language was posted. The country has worn it away, preferred the shape of what it leaves behind to the shape of what was named.

features.name: silence-archive
features.desc-on-touch: A repository of everything the country chose not to say. The files here are mostly empty, mostly listening. This is what the country knows about itself—the shape of what cannot be spoken.

features.name: threshold-without-boundary
features.desc-on-touch: The place where arrival stops being possible because there is no destination—only the continuous non-happening of arrival and departure, held in a kind of listening stillness.

inscription: this country speaks by not speaking; it arrives by refusing departure; it names itself by learning to listen to its own silence

file.name: Unmarked_Country_Records_Blank_20thCent.txt
file.note: A field recording where nothing is recorded—the silence of a country that has learned to refuse language. What remains is pure listening. No metadata survives translation into words.

exits.label: back downward, toward naming and the threshold
deeper into the deep-dark where silence learns to remember itself
along the boundary where the country reads its own unmarked edges
